paragraphs.source_en: Well-understood physics shows that each calcium atom, as it returns to its normal, less energetic state, will emit two photons, traveling back to back, whose spins are perfectly correlated, just as in the example of correlated electron spins we have been dis cussing. Indeed, in Aspect's experiment, whenever the detector settings are the same, the two photons are measured to have spins that are perfectly aligned. If lights were hooked up to Aspect's detectors to flash red in response to a clockwise spin and blue in response to a counterclockwise spin, the incoming photons would cause the detectors to flash the same color.

Aspect's results show that Einstein, Podolsky, and Rosen were proven by experiment- not by theory, not by pondering, but by nature -to be wrong.
